description:
Short circuit 360 is a team of electronic repair enthusiasts. The aim of this channel is to give you full access to electronic and laptop motherboard repair training tutorials from guest speakers and basics electronic materials for free -- no book sales, no membership. Everything we have we put on YouTube is for free so you can have it. 

I am available to answer your questions and be of help in helping you resolve electronics and laptop motherboard issues. 
You can email me at sirpeterson2011@gmail.com . I will respond to mails as fast as I can. 

Subscribe to this channel as your way of supporting me and what I do. 

Thank you.
